versions.content: If transmission of NM PDUs has been started and the UdpNm Message Cycle Timer expires an NM PDU shall be transmitted through the SoAd by calling SoAd_IfTransmit.

{DRAFT} If transmission of NM PDUs has been started, the UdpNm Message Cycle Timer expires and when UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to either FALSE or if set to TRUE and no request for a synchronized PNC shutdown is pending, then the UdpNm modul shall transmit an NM PDU by calling SoAd_IfTransmit.

{DRAFT} If transmission of NM PDUs has been started, the UdpNm Message Cycle Timer expires and when UdpNmSynchronizedPncShutdownEnabled is set to either FALSE or if set to TRUE and no request for a synchronized PNC shutdown is pending, then the UdpNm modul shall transmit an NM PDU by calling SoAd_IfTransmit.
